items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The neutral colours, light and dark, with success and warning, and a font family per Geist weight, in the form the engine compiles, and the fonts map that loads them.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn, which joins class values and lets a later Tailwind class win over an earlier one.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: usePresence, which keeps an overlay drawn while it animates in and out, useReducedMotion, which reads whether the system asks for reduced motion, usePopupMotion, the fade, grow and slide a menu, popover or tooltip opens and closes with, useSwipeToDismiss, the swipe that closes a toast, and usePulse, the fade a title pulses with while its work is under way.

items.name: icon-motion
items.title: Icon motion
items.description: useIconMotion, the progress an animated icon draws its parts from, IconHandle, through which a control plays the icon's motion out and back, still when the system asks for reduced motion, transformProps and dash, which turn the progress into a shape's transform and drawn stroke, iconTrigger, the press-in and focus handlers that start a control's icons, and usePlayOnReach, which plays a state icon once as its state is reached.

items.name: overlay
items.title: Overlay
items.description: usePortalHostCheck, which reports in development an overlay shown while no PortalHost draws it, and useModalOverlay and useModalOverlayShown, which keep screen readers inside an open modal overlay.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: useHighlight, which tracks whether a menu item is under a finger, the pointer or the keyboard's focus, pressClosing, what pressing an item does to its menu, webItemRole, an item's role on the web, and useMenuScrollHeight, the height a device scrolls a menu's items past.

items.name: command-score
items.title: Command score
items.description: commandScore, cmdk's fuzzy scorer, which Command filters its items with: how well the typed letters match a value and its keywords, in order.

items.name: text

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A pressable control announced as a button, in the style's variants and sizes.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, hidden from screen readers unless it marks a real boundary.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A muted placeholder block that pulses while content loads.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The text that names a field, with a nativeID for the field's aria-labelledby and an onPress for the caller to focus it.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small pill for a status or a count, in the style's variants, with its label and icon taking the variant's colours.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, title, description, content and footer, in the style's default and small spacing.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture of a person or account in three sizes, with a fallback that shows when the image is missing or fails to load, a badge on its corner, and a group that overlaps avatars and counts the rest.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar showing how far a task has got from 0 to 100, announced as a progress bar with its value, with a label that names it and the value as a percentage above it.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value, or a range of values, picked by dragging a thumb along a track, each thumb announced as adjustable with its value.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month's grid of days on which a day, several days or a range is selected, with today marked and buttons to the previous and next month.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides that a swipe or its named previous and next buttons scroll through one snap at a time, with Embla's api.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels side by side or stacked, sized in percent of their group, with handles that drag the room between two, each announced as adjustable and moved by the arrow keys on the web.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toasts raised with toast() from anywhere into a Toaster at the app's root, stacked, closed by a timer, a swipe or their buttons, and read by screen readers.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field in the style's look, with a focus border, an invalid state and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline text field at least four lines tall, with the same focus, invalid and disabled states as Input.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off control in the style's default and small sizes, announced as a switch, with an invalid border and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box with a check mark when checked, announced as a checkbox, with an invalid border and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: A column of round choices of which one is selected, announced as radios, with an invalid border and a dimmed disabled state per item or for the group.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button in the style's default and outline variants and three sizes, on the muted background while pressed, announced as a button that is selected while pressed, with a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A row or column of toggles of which one or several are pressed, spaced apart or joined into one bar, announced as radios or checkboxes.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Panels switched by a row of tabs, on a muted bar or underlined, of which only the selected panel is rendered, announced as a tab list of tabs.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A circle that turns while something loads, announced as a busy progress bar named Loading, standing still when the system is set to reduce motion.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An input or a multiline textarea with text, icons or buttons beside, above or below it, drawn as one field that takes the focus, invalid and disabled states of its input.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code in a row of slots, typed, pasted or filled from a texted code into one hidden field, with a caret on the next slot and an invalid state.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut drawn as a small muted cap, alone or with the other keys of a shortcut in a group.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A bordered box announced as an alert, with a title, a description, an optional icon beside them and an optional action at the top right, in a default or destructive variant.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A centred placeholder for a screen or section with nothing to show yet, with media, a title, a description and actions.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A frame whose height follows its width at a given ratio, for an image, a video or a map.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail from the top of the app to the current screen, a navigation landmark of links and separators with the current page marked.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons, and the text and separators beside them, joined into one control in a row or a column, announced as a group.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: The pages of a long list, a navigation landmark of page links with the current page outlined and marked, previous and next links and an ellipsis.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of content with media, a title, a description and actions, outlined or muted at three sizes, and a group that lists items.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A box of fixed size whose content scrolls inside it, vertically or sideways, with the platform scroll indicator.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of data announced as a table, with a header, a body, a footer and a caption, its cells sharing each row and the table scrolling sideways when wider than its box.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: The layout of a form: fields of a label, a control and a description or an error, in groups and sets named by a legend, stacked or in a row.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A region shown and hidden by a trigger announced as a button with its expanded state, closed or open by default or controlled.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of sections whose triggers, announced as buttons with their expanded state, open one section at a time or several, each growing open and shrinking closed unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A dialog that interrupts to confirm or acknowledge something, announced as a modal alertdialog named by its title, which a press outside it does not close, with a cancel button that does and an action button, fading in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window centred over a dimmed screen, announced as a modal dialog named by its title, closed by its close buttons, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel attached to one edge of the screen over a dimmed overlay, announced as a modal dialog named by its title, closed by its close buttons, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, sliding in from its side unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel attached to an edge of the screen over a dimmed overlay, announced as a modal dialog named by its title, closed by a swipe toward its edge, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, sliding in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel beside its trigger, announced as a dialog named by its title, closed by its trigger, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Links to the app's sections in a navigation landmark, with triggers that open a panel of more links on a press, or as the pointer rests on them on the web, one at a time, closed by a second press, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's side navigation: a sheet below the md width and a panel beside the screen from it, collapsing off the screen or to a rail of icons, with its open state in a provider, a toggle button, groups and menus.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label beside a control, opened by a press on a device and by hover or focus on the web, announced as a tooltip, closed by its trigger, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview of what a link leads to, beside it, opened by a press on a device and by hover on the web, closed by its trigger, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that opens from its trigger, with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and sub-menus, announced as a menu and closed by an item, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions on an area of the screen, opened by a long press or a right click where it landed, with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and sub-menus, announced as a menu and closed by an item, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A bar of menus, one open at a time, each with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and sub-menus, announced as a menubar of menus and closed by an item, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A field that picks one of a list of options, announced as a combobox whose options carry their selected state, showing the chosen option's label, closed by a choice, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A menu of commands searched by typing, whose typed text filters its items by cmdk's fuzzy score on value and keywords, highlighting the first match, moved by the arrow keys and run by the return key, with groups hidden while none of their items match, and a CommandDialog that holds it in a Dialog.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that picks one or, with multiple, any number of a long list of choices: a trigger announced as a combobox showing the chosen label, or chips of the chosen items, opening a Popover that holds a Command whose typed text filters the choices, the chosen ones announced as selected with a check mark, with a button that clears them.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: DirectionProvider and useDirection: the direction text reads in, the system's unless a provider sets it, which the web also lays its children out in; useDirectionSides, which way an item runs and the style keys and sides it places its parts by; and useMirrored, the style that turns an arrow for text read right to left.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: Upstream's NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption and NativeSelectOptGroup drawn with Select: a combobox showing its first option until another is chosen, opening a list of its options and named groups.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: No files, as upstream's: a form is Field bound to a form library, such as react-hook-form's Controller.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Upstream's base-ui toast: a Toaster at the app's root and a toast manager whose add, update, close and promise raise toasts from anywhere, stacked, closed by a timeout, a swipe or their close button, and read by screen readers.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Recharts' chart parts in Recharts' names, drawn with react-native-svg: bar, line, area, pie, radar and radial bar charts with their axes, grid, tooltip and legend, coloured through the palette a ChartContainer provides.

items.name: color-scheme
items.title: Color scheme
items.description: useColorScheme, which reads the colour scheme the app draws, light or dark, as the engine holds it.

items.name: chart-theme
items.title: Chart theme
items.description: useChartTheme, which reads the colour scheme the app draws and the theme colours a chart names, such as var(--chart-1), as the engine holds them.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Charts drawn in the colours and labels of a chart config, with a tooltip a press, a pointer or the arrow keys move, a legend, and the values read to screen readers.

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: Use highlighted code
items.description: useHighlightedCode, which highlights code with Shiki's JavaScript engine into one node per line for a CodeBlockLine, in the light or dark theme the app draws, loading each language the first time it is used.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: Use mobile
items.description: useIsMobile, whether the window is narrower than the md width, as a phone's is, following the window as it resizes.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers, highlighted lines and a copy button that tells screen readers it copied; long lines scroll sideways unless they wrap.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or an image in a card, with its upload state, three sizes, a horizontal or vertical layout, actions, a press area over the whole card, and a row that scrolls sideways.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line in a conversation that is not a message: a status announced as it changes, a system note, a row ruled underneath, or a label between two lines.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in a conversation: an avatar beside its bubbles, with a header and a footer, on either side of the row.

items.name: focus-visible
items.title: Focus visible
items.description: useFocusVisible, which says whether a control's focus came from the keyboard, so a focus ring is drawn for it and not after a press.

items.name: text-children
items.title: Text children
items.description: textOf, which reads the text a node draws, nested elements included, and asText, which sets children that are only strings and numbers in one Text, which a View cannot hold bare.

items.name: message-context
items.title: Message context
items.description: useMessage, which tells a Bubble or an Attachment the side of the Message it sits in, and lets a ghost Bubble tell the Message it is there.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A message's framed surface in seven variants, at the start or end of the row, with reactions overlapping its edge and content that can take a press.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: A conversation's scrolling transcript that opens at its end or its last turn, brings each new turn near the top, follows a streamed reply while the reader is at the end, keeps its place as history loads above, and has a button and hooks to jump to either end or to any message.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A form that asks one question at a time: progress, choices announced as radios or checkboxes, a free-text answer, an error for a required question left unanswered, and steps back, forward, skipped and submitted.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The steps an agent took, one under another, each with an icon, a title that pulses while it runs and a status, and steps whose detail opens under them.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field over Input Group whose toggle, named Show password or Hide password, shows or hides the password.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password strength
items.description: How strong a password is, as a three-step meter announced when it changes, and which of its requirements it meets, in a small card.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: A six-character one-time code over Input OTP, as one group of six slots or two groups of three, with 48 high slots that fill the row.

items.name: unsaved-changes-toolbar
items.title: Unsaved changes toolbar
items.description: A toolbar floating at the top or bottom of its parent while a form has unsaved changes, with a live message and Reset and Save buttons that are disabled while saving.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab bar
items.description: A bar of top-level destinations at one edge of the screen, a tablist of pressable tab items with an indicator, an icon, a label and a count badge.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status indicator
items.description: A small decorative dot colored by a semantic status tone (online, offline, busy or idle), hidden from screen readers, which can pulse for a state still in progress unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: unsaved-indicator
items.title: Unsaved indicator
items.description: The unsaved-changes dot an editor shows on a tab, announced as an image named Unsaved changes.

items.name: icon-media
items.title: Icon media
items.description: A small square that holds one glyph, its background and its glyph tinted through the caller's className, announced as an image when it is given a label.

items.name: icon-label
items.title: Icon label
items.description: A label whose icon stands in for a field's text in a dense panel, named for a screen reader by its aria-label, tied to its input through nativeID and sizing an Icon with no size of its own to a compact glyph.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: A decorative background of meteors falling across their parent, each a dot trailing a fading line, hidden from screen readers and drawn not at all when the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: animated-grid-pattern
items.title: Animated grid pattern
items.description: A decorative grid of lines across its parent in which cells fade in and out at random, hidden from screen readers and drawn still when the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: center
items.title: Center
items.description: A box that centers its children on both axes, stretched or kept to its content's width, with its element swappable through render.

items.name: page-container
items.title: Page container
items.description: The centered, max-width content column of a full-width surface, sized from a named max-width scale.

items.name: panel-header
items.title: Panel header
items.description: The top strip of a side panel: one or more rows of a title and trailing actions over a bottom border.

items.name: panel-row
items.title: Panel row
items.description: One row of a property section, its fields beside a trailing action column that keeps every row's right edge aligned.

items.name: panel-field-group
items.title: Panel field group
items.description: The tight grid for paired and triplet inputs in a property panel, with any number of columns.

items.name: collapsible-card
items.title: Collapsible card
items.description: A collapsible card with a header and body, open by default, on a card, muted or plain surface, whose trigger is announced as a button with its expanded state.

items.name: reasoning-collapsible
items.title: Reasoning collapsible
items.description: A thinking disclosure that opens itself while a reasoning stream is live, pulses its label meanwhile unless the system asks for reduced motion, and closes shortly after the stream ends.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: An icon button that copies its value to the clipboard, showing a check and taking its copied name until its timeout resets it, and telling screen readers it copied.

items.name: file-type-icon
items.title: File type icon
items.description: A lucide icon chosen for a file's type from its extension, hidden from screen readers unless given an aria-label.

items.name: font-preview
items.title: Font preview
items.description: A specimen of a font file at several sizes, one row per size, loaded through expo-font under a family scoped to the instance.

items.name: image-preview
items.title: Image preview
items.description: A frame that shows an image contained within it, over a checkerboard so transparent pixels read clearly.

items.name: permission-card
items.title: Permission card
items.description: An inline, non-modal AI-consent request that stays in scrollback after it resolves, showing its decision row while pending and its resolved row once the host settles its status.

items.name: ai-provider-card
items.title: AI provider card
items.description: A small card for one AI provider in an overview grid, whose footer note carries a status dot and whose trigger, a button under its content, selects it on a press anywhere but its action.

items.name: model-info-card
items.title: Model info card
items.description: The detail panel for one model: an identity header composed from Item parts over titled sections, each marked by an accent bar in a chart colour.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat message
items.description: One chat message row over Message, with a line before its leading edge, hidden from screen readers, while its text is still streaming.

items.name: chat-suggestion-item
items.title: Chat suggestion item
items.description: One starter prompt in an empty conversation, an Item drawn as a button that hands its prompt to onSelectPrompt when pressed, and is disabled without it.

items.name: floating-toolbar
items.title: Floating toolbar
items.description: A floating card-color toolbar shell with a hairline border and a shadow, announced as a toolbar around the tools the caller composes.

items.name: editor-tab
items.title: Editor tab
items.description: One tab in an editor's tab strip, muted until active, whose close button shows at all times, with the unsaved dot before it on a dirty tab that is not active.

items.name: expr-eval
items.title: Expression evaluator
items.description: evaluateExpression, which works out simple arithmetic typed into a number field, such as 100 + 8 or (4 + 2) * 3, with + - * /, parentheses and decimals, and gives null for anything else.

items.name: language-options
items.title: Language options
items.description: The code languages the design system highlights, with their labels and code-fence aliases, the locale options labelled with each language's own name where the runtime can name it, and findLanguageOption, which finds the option a value or its alias carries.

items.name: fluent-emoji
items.title: Fluent emoji
items.description: fluentEmojiUrl, an emoji glyph's Fluent artwork URL on the house CDN in one of five styles, or none where the package's manifest lists no artwork for it, and FluentEmoji, which draws that artwork through expo-image, tints the black mono style the foreground colour, and draws the glyph as text where there is no artwork or it fails to load.

items.name: brand-mark
items.title: Brand mark
items.description: BrandMark, a brand's mark from the @zeroxsolutions/icons CDN drawn through expo-image, falling along its variants to the name's first letter when a file is missing or fails to load and tinting the one-colour variants the foreground colour, and AiProviderIcon, the mark an AI provider's key resolves to, or a sparkle for a key that resolves to none.

items.name: language-toggle-group
items.title: Language toggle group
items.description: Every language shown inline as a single-choice toggle group for a small fixed set, announced as a radio group, which never deselects so a language is always chosen.

items.name: emoji-appearance-toggle-group
items.title: Emoji appearance toggle group
items.description: A single-choice row of swatches for choosing the Fluent emoji artwork style, each previewing the same sample emoji in its own style before its label, announced as a radio group named Emoji style.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A command palette for jumping to a target: a controlled CommandDialog holding a Command that reports the chosen item's value and closes when an item is chosen.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A compact numeric field for a property inspector over Input Group, which works out arithmetic such as 100 + 8, clamps to min and max and commits on the return key or on leaving the field; Escape drops the draft and the arrows step where the keyboard reports those keys.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: A tag editor with removable chips above a field that adds a new tag on the return key, a comma or leaving the field, and never adds a duplicate.

items.name: language-combobox
items.title: Language combobox
items.description: A searchable language picker over Combobox, for UI locales or the code languages the design system highlights, that shows a code alias such as ts as its language and reports the value picked.

items.name: frontmatter-form
items.title: Frontmatter form
items.description: A frontmatter (YAML metadata) editor over Field: the caller composes one field per key, each control named by its label and bound to its value, and an invalid field's error shown and given to the control as its hint.

items.name: resize-drag
items.title: Resize drag
items.description: shouldStartDrag, which says whether a press has moved far enough from where it went down to begin a resize, 4px either way by default, so a tap, a jitter or a double tap never resizes.

items.name: tree-item
items.title: Tree item
items.description: One row of a hierarchy tree, drawn as the file tree's rows, with a depth indent, a disclosure trigger announced expanded or collapsed, a pressable label and an inline rename input that commits on the return key or on leaving the field.

items.name: data-table-column-header
items.title: Data table column header
items.description: A @tanstack/react-table column's sort-and-hide menu, taking the column directly rather than a shared table instance, its trigger showing the column's sort direction.

items.name: model-list
items.title: Model list
items.description: The frame for a model list section: a header with a title announced as a heading over a scrolling content area, a remove button for one model, and placeholder items while the list loads.

items.name: resize-handle
items.title: Resize handle
items.description: A vertical resize grip for a panel outside any Resizable group, which reports its drag only once the finger has moved 4px, toggles on a double tap and is announced as adjustable.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: The parts of a @tanstack/react-table view - toolbar, view, pagination and view options - reading one shared table instance from context.

items.name: code-language
items.title: Code language
items.description: isPlainLanguage, which says whether a code-fence language id is absent or names plain text, and languageLabel, the display name of a language id, case-insensitive, or the id itself when unlisted.

items.name: code-card
items.title: Code card
items.description: Read-only source over a collapsible card, highlighted by the registry's highlighter and plain until the grammar loads, with its language, line numbers and a copy action.

items.name: url-transform
items.title: URL transform
items.description: defaultUrlTransform, which keeps a URL that is relative or names http, https, irc, ircs, mailto or xmpp and empties any other, as react-markdown's own filter does, so a javascript:, data: or vbscript: link never opens.

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: Markdown view
items.description: A GitHub-Flavored Markdown string drawn in native parts styled to the design tokens, with tables as the registry's Table, task items as read-only checkboxes and fenced code as a Code card; raw HTML is dropped and a link opens only on a safe URL.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: An accessible file tree that owns selection and folder expansion, controlled or uncontrolled: a press selects a row and toggles a folder, and the arrow, Home, End, Enter and Space keys move through it where the platform reports keys.

items.name: emoji-picker-rows
items.title: Emoji picker rows
items.description: emojiPickerRows, which lays an emoji picker's sections out as list rows, a heading per section then its emoji eight to a row, or search results alone eight to a row with no heading, and says which rows are headings.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji picker
items.description: A searchable, categorized emoji list with an optional frequent row and a category nav, mounting only the rows near the screen under a heading per category that sticks to the top, so opening the catalog fetches only the artwork in view.

items.name: avatar-picker-check-color
items.title: Avatar picker check color
items.description: avatarPickerCheckColor, which picks white or near-black for the check on an avatar colour swatch, whichever contrasts more with a #rgb or #rrggbb colour by WCAG's relative luminance, and white for a colour it cannot read.

items.name: avatar-picker
items.title: Avatar picker
items.description: A Popover-based avatar editor whose emoji, upload and colour panes edit one avatar value: an emoji from the emoji picker, a photo from the device's library handed to an optional upload, or a swatch or hex colour.

items.name: ai-provider-picker
items.title: AI provider picker
items.description: A responsive grid of AI provider cards, from the host's entries or a sample, that calls back with the provider key a card selects.
